examples.text_en: They used a new system for the propulsion of the thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一种新系统来推进这个东西。

examples.text_en: The king would prorogue the group for a month.
examples.text_zh: 国王会让这个团体休会一个月。

examples.text_en: They will prorogue the meeting until a later time.
examples.text_zh: 他们会让会议休会到稍后。

examples.text_en: His daily life was quiet and prosaic.
examples.text_zh: 他的日常生活平淡而乏味。

examples.text_en: The report was prosaic but very clear.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告平淡却很清晰。

examples.text_en: The rules proscribe any talking during the test.
examples.text_zh: 规定禁止考试期间说话。

examples.text_en: This law proscribes certain kinds of trade.
examples.text_zh: 这条法律禁止某些种类的贸易。

examples.text_en: The state will prosecute anyone who breaks the law.
examples.text_zh: 国家将起诉任何违法的人。

examples.text_en: They decided not to prosecute the young thief.
examples.text_zh: 他们决定不起诉那个年轻小偷。

examples.text_en: The prosecution presented its case to the jury.
examples.text_zh: 控方向陪审团陈述了案情。

examples.text_en: She faced prosecution for a minor offence.
examples.text_zh: 她因一项轻微违法行为面临起诉。

examples.text_en: They tried to proselytize among the local farmers.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图在当地农民中劝人改宗。

examples.text_en: He would proselytize anyone who would listen.
examples.text_zh: 他会向任何愿意听的人劝教。

examples.text_en: The prospect of a new job made him very happy.
examples.text_zh: 新工作的前景让他非常高兴。

examples.text_en: The view gave us a fine prospect of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 这景色让我们看到了大海的美景。

examples.text_en: They spent the summer prospecting for gold.
examples.text_zh: 他们整个夏天都在勘探黄金。

examples.text_en: His prospecting work took him far from home.
examples.text_zh: 他的勘探工作让他远离家乡。

examples.text_en: She met several prospective buyers at the fair.
examples.text_zh: 她在展销会上见了几位潜在买家。

examples.text_en: The prospective students toured the college today.
examples.text_zh: 今天这些预备学生参观了学院。

examples.text_en: The prospector searched the hills for gold.
examples.text_zh: 勘探者在山丘间寻找黄金。

examples.text_en: A lonely prospector found a rich vein.
examples.text_zh: 一个孤独的勘探者发现了富矿脉。

examples.text_en: The school sent us a detailed prospectus.
examples.text_zh: 学校给我们寄来一份详细的简介。

examples.text_en: She read the prospectus before choosing the course.
examples.text_zh: 她在选课之前读了课程简介。

examples.text_en: The small business will prosper that year.
examples.text_zh: 这家小企业那一年会兴旺起来。

examples.text_en: Good people can prosper with hard work and care.
examples.text_zh: 善良的人靠努力和用心就能兴旺。
